calibration.target: Subsequent gross win income before the ninth own draw (including replacements) or round end; initial win excluded.
calibration.fitting: Nonnegative through-origin OLS on first half of SOURCE SEEDS per profile. Remaining seeds never used in fit.
calibration.caveat: Accepted self-draw wins only; policy-dependent sample. Coefficient is an offline forecast calibration, not validated action-value correction or a deployable strength gain.
